head: Pixel November update not showing on T-Mobile, Mint and Tello
dek: Two weeks after Google released the November Pixel Drop on 10 November, many Pixel phones on T-Mobile and the Mint and Tello networks are still on the October update, though a few owners now report it installing.
details: The delay reportedly hits several Pixel generations, including the Pixel 11 series. A few owners report it on a Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 8a, Pixel 9a and Pixel 10 on T-Mobile. Neither Google nor T-Mobile has explained the delay. Some owners who installed it by hand report problems afterwards, such as wireless charging not working.
where: US, Pixel phones on T-Mobile, Mint Mobile and Tello
means: If your Pixel is on T-Mobile, Mint or Tello and still shows the October update, you're not alone: the update hasn't reached many phones on these networks yet.
todo: Check Settings, System, Software updates from time to time. Installing it by hand has caused problems for some owners.
